scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward. indis class-1 probability is the deployed referent score. best_query is the query with the largest mask-overlap with the target; selected_query is the indis argmax. Margin is best minus selected, so a negative value means the deployed head ranks the correct query ABOVE its chosen one. This is a ranking-head diagnostic only; ranking mechanisms are a closed direction and nothing here is admitted. No model, novelty, efficacy or resource claim.
